BiblicalUsage: Ummah is a town in Asher, named in the list of the tribe's inheritance. In Joshua 19:30, Ummah also, and Aphek.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Ummah matters because the gospel travelled through real places, and God met His people where they lived.
